recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If the work group wants FHIR core to expose the exact Argonaut code value-reference as an additional alias, that should be handled as a new explicit search-parameter naming decision rather than inferred from FHIR-34541.
issue_request: FHIR-34541 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by FHIR-I. It asked to add a Group value-reference search parameter based on the Argonaut Patient Lists SearchParameter whose code was value-reference, type was reference, and expression targeted Group.characteristic.value as Reference.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-34541. The same source-change family is FHIR-28291, a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue requesting Group characteristic-reference search support; commit 7b5847c83c5ea46b8982c2cb4e974103c8f69fcf added Group-characteristic-reference on 2022-08-09. Eric Haas then commented on FHIR-34541 on 2022-08-19 that it was already applied. R4/R4B history artifacts lack the Group characteristic-reference search include, while R5 history artifacts include it.
additional_context: The cited Argonaut Patient Lists SearchParameter used the code value-reference and described using it together with the standard characteristic parameter. FHIR core settled on the name characteristic-reference for the same reference-valued characteristic search capability. Later source maintenance converted the parameter into the current composite form so the characteristic code and reference value are matched together, and the later FHIR-40341 reconciliation fixed the current reference component expression. Group is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml is the authoritative current Group search-parameter bundle.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active Group search-parameter bundle already contains Group-characteristic-reference as a composite with a characteristic component and a reference component using value.ofType(Reference). Adding a second value-reference alias now would create a new search contract not supported by the R5/R6 core naming trail or the current Group search-parameter family.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive issue whose application added the current core Group characteristic-reference search parameter that FHIR-34541 was later marked as already applying.
Later Group search reconciliation fixed the current characteristic-reference component expression and related Group search-parameter defects without adding a separate value-reference alias.
